promotion_requirements: Relevant prior-art review completed sufficiently to avoid obvious rediscovery.
governance_rules: ICR-001: Conceptual novelty is not scientific evidence.
ICR-002: Terminological novelty is not methodological novelty.
ICR-003: Analogy is not a theoretical bridge.
ICR-004: A candidate generated by SCAMPER/TRIZ/combination/reverse thinking does not become a scientific hypothesis merely because it is coherent.
ICR-005: Existing experimental results may motivate a candidate but do not support predictions generated only after those outcomes were observed.
ICR-006: Candidate activation must obey dependency gates.
ICR-007: Candidate promotion requires prospective falsifiability.
ICR-008: Scientific Spine advancement and information gain take priority over idea novelty or aesthetic appeal.
ICR-009: A candidate may remain permanently unresolved or never activated.
ICR-010: Failure to activate a candidate does not erase its historical provenance.
ICR-011: User-originated mathematical intuition must not be silently upgraded into a mathematical theorem or derived consequence.
ICR-012: AI synthesis must not be retroactively attributed to earlier experiments or to the user unless directly supported by provenance.
ICR-013: Later terminology must not be retroactively attributed to early work unless an explicit mapping exists.
ICR-014: An innovation candidate may not modify the interpretation of a completed canonical experiment.
ICR-015: Innovation candidates must not automatically determine the next experiment.
ICR-016: Candidate selection for experimentation must occur through a separate scientific route review.

Paper_A.note: No innovation candidate activation required. Do not retrofit innovation candidates into Paper A.

candidates.name: Minimal Operator Complexity Profile
candidates.core_question: What is the minimum prospectively ordered operator complexity required to satisfy a registered alignment criterion?
candidates.candidate_formalization: k* = min { k : T_k satisfies prospectively registered criterion }
blocking_dependencies: prospective operator evidence / validated operator ladder
candidates.forbidden_inference: k* does not establish transport, invariant preservation, semantic equivalence, or Functional Binding.
candidates.promotion_gate: construct_definition + operationalization + falsifiable_prediction + dependencies + claim_ceiling + prospective_test_route + prior_art_review + route_review

candidates.name: Profile-to-Mechanism Predictor
candidates.core_question: Can prospectively frozen compatibility-profile variables predict the minimum operator class required by a new model?
candidates.claim_ceiling: A frozen profile-to-operator predictor is prospective only until tested on an independent model.
candidates.forbidden_inference: Three discovery models may not be used as both unrestricted predictor discovery data and independent confirmatory evidence.
candidates.target_paper: Paper B extension / independent mechanism paper
candidates.promotion_gate: construct_definition + operationalization + falsifiable_prediction + dependencies + claim_ceiling + prospective_test_route + prior_art_review + route_review
candidates.notes: Best falsification asset: fourth independent language model.

candidates.name: Matched-Recovery Structural Dissociation
candidates.core_question: Can two transformations achieve matched functional recovery while differing materially in structural preservation and/or downstream validity?
candidates.scientific_construct: Matched functional recovery with structural dissociation
candidates.candidate_formalization: Recovery(T_A) ~= Recovery(T_B) while StructuralDamage(T_A) != StructuralDamage(T_B), and eventually DownstreamValidity(T_A) != DownstreamValidity(T_B)
candidates.claim_ceiling: Dissociation evidence does not itself establish an invariant.
candidates.forbidden_inference: Matched recovery is not invariant preservation.
candidates.promotion_gate: construct_definition + operationalization + falsifiable_prediction + dependencies + claim_ceiling + prospective_test_route + prior_art_review + route_review

candidates.name: Structure-Constrained Minimum Alignment
candidates.core_question: Can minimum operator complexity be formulated with an explicit structural-preservation constraint?
candidates.scientific_construct: Constrained optimization framework for alignment operators
candidates.candidate_formalization: min Complexity(T) subject to Recovery(T) >= tau and StructuralViolation(T) <= epsilon
blocking_dependencies: no independently validated structural invariant or structural constraint
candidates.claim_ceiling: This is a prospective formulation, not an identified structural invariant.
candidates.forbidden_inference: RSM/IVS must not automatically substitute for the missing independent structural criterion.
candidates.promotion_gate: construct_definition + operationalization + falsifiable_prediction + dependencies + claim_ceiling + prospective_test_route + prior_art_review + route_review

candidates.name: Local-to-Global Transformation Composition
candidates.core_question: Does a direct cross-depth transformation approximately equal the composition of prospectively validated local transformations?
candidates.claim_ceiling: A composition test is a future mechanism test, not support for Residual-Flow.
candidates.forbidden_inference: Current EXP-026/027 distance structure does not by itself support composition.
candidates.target_paper: Residual-Flow mechanism paper / Paper B extension
candidates.promotion_gate: construct_definition + operationalization + falsifiable_prediction + dependencies + claim_ceiling + prospective_test_route + prior_art_review + route_review

candidates.name: Composition Consistency and Path Dependence
candidates.core_question: Does local composition reproduce direct transformation, and does the resulting transformation depend on path/order?
candidates.scientific_construct: Transformation composition consistency and path dependence
candidates.candidate_formalization: Local composition vs direct transformation; path/order dependence
candidates.claim_ceiling: Path dependence may be measured only after operators and composition semantics are defined.
candidates.forbidden_inference: Path dependence must not be called noncommutative algebra until multiple validated operators and explicit composition semantics exist.

candidates.forbidden_inference: Cross-domain profile similarity alone does not establish residual architecture causality.

candidates.name: Counterexample-Guided Invariant Discovery
candidates.core_question: Instead of guessing an invariant first, can matched-recovery valid/invalid transformation pairs be used to discover structural quantities that discriminate them?
candidates.candidate_formalization: construct matched functional recovery -> identify structural dissociation -> search candidate structural quantities -> freeze candidate invariant prospectively -> test on fresh transformations
candidates.claim_ceiling: A discovered discriminating statistic must be frozen prospectively before being called an invariant.
candidates.forbidden_inference: A discriminating structural statistic is not automatically an invariant.
